{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Docs

# Builds, validates and deploys the Sphinx documentation.
#
# - Pull requests: full build + validation and a Vercel preview deployment for
#   branches of this repository. Forks and Dependabot PRs get build +
#   validation only, because GitHub withholds Actions secrets from both.
# - Push to master: the validated artifact is deployed to the dedicated docs
#   Vercel project (the origin behind https://www.optiland.org/docs/), then
#   smoke-tested through both the origin alias and the first-party route.
# - Weekly schedule / manual: external link check and production smoke test.
#
# API pages are generated from docstrings, so pushes to master always rebuild
# regardless of which paths changed. Required secrets (environment
# "docs-production", also available to preview deployments): VERCEL_TOKEN,
# VERCEL_ORG_ID, VERCEL_DOCS_PROJECT_ID, DOCS_ORIGIN_URL.

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [master]
    paths:
      - "docs/**"
      - "optiland/**"
      - "optiland_gui/**"
      - "pyproject.toml"
      - "uv.lock"
      - ".readthedocs.yaml"
      - "scripts/docs/**"
      - ".github/workflows/docs.yml"
  push:
    branches: [master]
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: "17 5 * * 1"

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  DOCS_BASE_URL: https://www.optiland.org/docs/
  SPHINX_OUTPUT: docs/_build/html
  PYTHONIOENCODING: utf-8

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build and validate
    if: github.event_name != 'schedule'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    concurrency:
      group: docs-build-${{ github.ref }}
      cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0 # versioningit and page "last updated" dates need history and tags

      - name: Create the documentation environment (docs/build-environment.yml)
        uses: mamba-org/setup-micromamba@v2
        with:
          environment-file: docs/build-environment.yml
          cache-environment: true
          cache-environment-key: docs-env-${{ hashFiles('docs/build-environment.yml', 'pyproject.toml', 'uv.lock') }}

      - name: Reject links to the retired Read the Docs site
        run: python3 scripts/docs/check_no_rtd_links.py

      - name: Build documentation
        shell: bash -el {0}
        run: |
          python scripts/docs/build_docs.py \
            --canonical-base-url "$DOCS_BASE_URL" \
            --git-sha "$GITHUB_SHA" \
            --warnings-log docs/_build/warnings.log

      - name: Validate build
        shell: bash -el {0}
        run: |
          python scripts/docs/validate_build.py "$SPHINX_OUTPUT" \
            --base-url "$DOCS_BASE_URL" \
            --warnings docs/_build/warnings.log \
            --allowlist scripts/docs/warnings-allowlist.txt \
            --report docs/_build/validation.json

      - name: Package for Vercel (Build Output API)
        shell: bash -el {0}
        run: python scripts/docs/prepare_vercel_output.py --source "$SPHINX_OUTPUT" --output .vercel/output

      - name: Build summary
        if: always()
        shell: bash -el {0}
        run: |
          {
            echo "## Documentation build"
            echo
            echo "- Source: \`$GITHUB_SHA\`"
            if [ -f "$SPHINX_OUTPUT/_meta/build.json" ]; then
              echo "- Version: \`$(python -c 'import json;print(json.load(open("docs/_build/html/_meta/build.json"))["docs_version"])')\`"
            fi
            echo "- Pages: $(find "$SPHINX_OUTPUT" -name '*.html' | wc -l)"
            echo "- Size: $(du -sh .vercel/output/static 2>/dev/null | cut -f1)"
            echo "- Warnings: $(grep -c . docs/_build/warnings.log 2>/dev/null || echo 0) line(s)"
            echo
            if [ -s docs/_build/warnings.log ]; then
              echo "<details><summary>Sphinx warnings</summary>"; echo; echo '```'
              head -c 20000 docs/_build/warnings.log; echo '```'; echo "</details>"
            fi
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: docs-site
          path: .vercel/output
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: error

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: docs-logs
          path: |
            docs/_build/warnings.log
            docs/_build/validation.json
          if-no-files-found: warn

  preview:
    name: Preview deployment
    needs: build
    # Forks and Dependabot runs get no Actions secrets, so they cannot deploy.
    if: >-
      github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
      github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
      github.event.pull_request.user.login != 'dependabot[bot]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    environment:
      name: docs-preview
    env:
      VERCEL_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }}
      VERCEL_ORG_ID: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_ORG_ID }}
      VERCEL_PROJECT_ID: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_DOCS_PROJECT_ID }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: docs-site
          path: .vercel/output
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - name: Deploy preview
        id: deploy
        run: |
          npm install --global vercel@latest
          url=$(vercel deploy --prebuilt --archive=tgz --token="$VERCEL_TOKEN" --yes)
          echo "url=$url" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Preview: $url" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
      - name: Smoke test preview
        # Pull request runs build the merge ref, so the artifact is stamped
        # with github.sha (the merge commit), not the branch head.
        run: python3 scripts/docs/smoke_test.py --base-url "${{ steps.deploy.outputs.url }}/" --expect-commit "${{ github.sha }}"

  deploy:
    name: Production deployment
    needs: build
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    environment:
      name: docs-production
      url: https://www.optiland.org/docs/
    concurrency:
      group: docs-production
      cancel-in-progress: false
    env:
      VERCEL_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }}
      VERCEL_ORG_ID: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_ORG_ID }}
      VERCEL_PROJECT_ID: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_DOCS_PROJECT_ID }}
      DOCS_ORIGIN_URL: ${{ secrets.DOCS_ORIGIN_URL }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: docs-site
          path: .vercel/output
      - name: Assert the artifact was built from this commit
        run: |
          built=$(python3 -c 'import json;print(json.load(open(".vercel/output/static/_meta/build.json"))["source_commit"])')
          test "$built" = "$GITHUB_SHA" || { echo "artifact commit $built != $GITHUB_SHA"; exit 1; }
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - name: Deploy to the docs origin (atomic; promoted only on success)
        id: deploy
        run: |
          npm install --global vercel@latest
          url=$(vercel deploy --prebuilt --prod --archive=tgz --token="$VERCEL_TOKEN" --yes)
          echo "url=$url" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          {
            echo "## Documentation deployment"
            echo "- Source: \`$GITHUB_SHA\`"
            echo "- Deployment: $url"
            echo "- Origin alias: $DOCS_ORIGIN_URL"
            echo "- First-party: https://www.optiland.org/docs/"
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
      - name: Smoke test the origin alias
        run: python3 scripts/docs/smoke_test.py --base-url "$DOCS_ORIGIN_URL/" --expect-commit "$GITHUB_SHA"
      - name: Smoke test the first-party route
        run: |
          # The website rewrite serves the same origin; allow a short window for CDN caches to refresh.
          for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do
            if python3 scripts/docs/smoke_test.py --base-url "$DOCS_BASE_URL" --expect-commit "$GITHUB_SHA" --first-party; then exit 0; fi
            echo "attempt $attempt failed; retrying in 60s"; sleep 60
          done
          echo "First-party smoke test failed. Roll back with: vercel rollback --token=... (see docs/contributing.rst)."
          exit 1

  linkcheck:
    name: External link check
    if: github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: mamba-org/setup-micromamba@v2
        with:
          environment-file: docs/build-environment.yml
          cache-environment: true
          cache-environment-key: docs-env-${{ hashFiles('docs/build-environment.yml', 'pyproject.toml', 'uv.lock') }}
      - name: Check external links (third-party failures are reported, not blocking)
        shell: bash -el {0}
        run: |
          OPTILAND_DOCS_SKIP_JUPYTERLITE=1 python -m sphinx -b linkcheck --keep-going docs docs/_build/linkcheck || true
          echo "## External link check" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if [ -f docs/_build/linkcheck/output.txt ]; then
            echo '```' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"; head -c 20000 docs/_build/linkcheck/output.txt >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"; echo '```' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi
      - name: Fail on broken first-party links (optiland.org, github.com/optiland)
        shell: bash -el {0}
        run: |
          if [ -f docs/_build/linkcheck/output.txt ] && grep -E "broken.*(optiland\.org|github\.com/optiland)" docs/_build/linkcheck/output.txt; then
            echo "Broken first-party links found"; exit 1
          fi
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: docs-linkcheck
          path: docs/_build/linkcheck
          if-no-files-found: warn

  production-smoke:
    name: Production smoke test
    if: github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Verify https://www.optiland.org/docs/
        run: python3 scripts/docs/smoke_test.py --base-url "$DOCS_BASE_URL" --first-party",
  "rationale": "The workflow has no explicit job-level timeouts, so every job relies on the default 6-hour limit. CI history shows successful runs complete in roughly 9-21 minutes. Adding explicit timeouts (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT) with generous headroom bounds runaway job consumption without reducing build, validation, preview, deploy, linkcheck, or smoke-test coverage. The pattern reports custom timeouts reduce runaway consumption (vm_time_reduction_percent 12.9% free, 8.1% paid). Timeouts were sized from observed history: build 60 min, preview/deploy/linkcheck 30 min, production-smoke 10 min.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT"]
}

name: Docs

# Builds, validates and deploys the Sphinx documentation.
#
# - Pull requests: full build + validation and a Vercel preview deployment for
#   branches of this repository. Forks and Dependabot PRs get build +
#   validation only, because GitHub withholds Actions secrets from both.
# - Push to master: the validated artifact is deployed to the dedicated docs
#   Vercel project (the origin behind https://www.optiland.org/docs/), then
#   smoke-tested through both the origin alias and the first-party route.
# - Weekly schedule / manual: external link check and production smoke test.
#
# API pages are generated from docstrings, so pushes to master always rebuild
# regardless of which paths changed. Required secrets (environment
# "docs-production", also available to preview deployments): VERCEL_TOKEN,
# VERCEL_ORG_ID, VERCEL_DOCS_PROJECT_ID, DOCS_ORIGIN_URL.

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [master]
    paths:
      - "docs/**"
      - "optiland/**"
      - "optiland_gui/**"
      - "pyproject.toml"
      - "uv.lock"
      - ".readthedocs.yaml"
      - "scripts/docs/**"
      - ".github/workflows/docs.yml"
  push:
    branches: [master]
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: "17 5 * * 1"

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  DOCS_BASE_URL: https://www.optiland.org/docs/
  SPHINX_OUTPUT: docs/_build/html
  PYTHONIOENCODING: utf-8

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build and validate
    if: github.event_name != 'schedule'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    concurrency:
      group: docs-build-${{ github.ref }}
      cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0 # versioningit and page "last updated" dates need history and tags

      - name: Create the documentation environment (docs/build-environment.yml)
        uses: mamba-org/setup-micromamba@v2
        with:
          environment-file: docs/build-environment.yml
          cache-environment: true
          cache-environment-key: docs-env-${{ hashFiles('docs/build-environment.yml', 'pyproject.toml', 'uv.lock') }}

      - name: Reject links to the retired Read the Docs site
        run: python3 scripts/docs/check_no_rtd_links.py

      - name: Build documentation
        shell: bash -el {0}
        run: |
          python scripts/docs/build_docs.py \
            --canonical-base-url "$DOCS_BASE_URL" \
            --git-sha "$GITHUB_SHA" \
            --warnings-log docs/_build/warnings.log

      - name: Validate build
        shell: bash -el {0}
        run: |
          python scripts/docs/validate_build.py "$SPHINX_OUTPUT" \
            --base-url "$DOCS_BASE_URL" \
            --warnings docs/_build/warnings.log \
            --allowlist scripts/docs/warnings-allowlist.txt \
            --report docs/_build/validation.json

      - name: Package for Vercel (Build Output API)
        shell: bash -el {0}
        run: python scripts/docs/prepare_vercel_output.py --source "$SPHINX_OUTPUT" --output .vercel/output

      - name: Build summary
        if: always()
        shell: bash -el {0}
        run: |
          {
            echo "## Documentation build"
            echo
            echo "- Source: \`$GITHUB_SHA\`"
            if [ -f "$SPHINX_OUTPUT/_meta/build.json" ]; then
              echo "- Version: \`$(python -c 'import json;print(json.load(open("docs/_build/html/_meta/build.json"))["docs_version"])')\`"
            fi
            echo "- Pages: $(find "$SPHINX_OUTPUT" -name '*.html' | wc -l)"
            echo "- Size: $(du -sh .vercel/output/static 2>/dev/null | cut -f1)"
            echo "- Warnings: $(grep -c . docs/_build/warnings.log 2>/dev/null || echo 0) line(s)"
            echo
            if [ -s docs/_build/warnings.log ]; then
              echo "<details><summary>Sphinx warnings</summary>"; echo; echo '```'
              head -c 20000 docs/_build/warnings.log; echo '```'; echo "</details>"
            fi
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: docs-site
          path: .vercel/output
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: error

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: docs-logs
          path: |
            docs/_build/warnings.log
            docs/_build/validation.json
          if-no-files-found: warn

  preview:
    name: Preview deployment
    needs: build
    # Forks and Dependabot runs get no Actions secrets, so they cannot deploy.
    if: >-
      github.event_name == 'pull_request' &&
      github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
      github.event.pull_request.user.login != 'dependabot[bot]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    environment:
      name: docs-preview
    env:
      VERCEL_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }}
      VERCEL_ORG_ID: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_ORG_ID }}
      VERCEL_PROJECT_ID: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_DOCS_PROJECT_ID }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: docs-site
          path: .vercel/output
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - name: Deploy preview
        id: deploy
        run: |
          npm install --global vercel@latest
          url=$(vercel deploy --prebuilt --archive=tgz --token="$VERCEL_TOKEN" --yes)
          echo "url=$url" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Preview: $url" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
      - name: Smoke test preview
        # Pull request runs build the merge ref, so the artifact is stamped
        # with github.sha (the merge commit), not the branch head.
        run: python3 scripts/docs/smoke_test.py --base-url "${{ steps.deploy.outputs.url }}/" --expect-commit "${{ github.sha }}"

  deploy:
    name: Production deployment
    needs: build
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    environment:
      name: docs-production
      url: https://www.optiland.org/docs/
    concurrency:
      group: docs-production
      cancel-in-progress: false
    env:
      VERCEL_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }}
      VERCEL_ORG_ID: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_ORG_ID }}
      VERCEL_PROJECT_ID: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_DOCS_PROJECT_ID }}
      DOCS_ORIGIN_URL: ${{ secrets.DOCS_ORIGIN_URL }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: docs-site
          path: .vercel/output
      - name: Assert the artifact was built from this commit
        run: |
          built=$(python3 -c 'import json;print(json.load(open(".vercel/output/static/_meta/build.json"))["source_commit"])')
          test "$built" = "$GITHUB_SHA" || { echo "artifact commit $built != $GITHUB_SHA"; exit 1; }
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - name: Deploy to the docs origin (atomic; promoted only on success)
        id: deploy
        run: |
          npm install --global vercel@latest
          url=$(vercel deploy --prebuilt --prod --archive=tgz --token="$VERCEL_TOKEN" --yes)
          echo "url=$url" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          {
            echo "## Documentation deployment"
            echo "- Source: \`$GITHUB_SHA\`"
            echo "- Deployment: $url"
            echo "- Origin alias: $DOCS_ORIGIN_URL"
            echo "- First-party: https://www.optiland.org/docs/"
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
      - name: Smoke test the origin alias
        run: python3 scripts/docs/smoke_test.py --base-url "$DOCS_ORIGIN_URL/" --expect-commit "$GITHUB_SHA"
      - name: Smoke test the first-party route
        run: |
          # The website rewrite serves the same origin; allow a short window for CDN caches to refresh.
          for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do
            if python3 scripts/docs/smoke_test.py --base-url "$DOCS_BASE_URL" --expect-commit "$GITHUB_SHA" --first-party; then exit 0; fi
            echo "attempt $attempt failed; retrying in 60s"; sleep 60
          done
          echo "First-party smoke test failed. Roll back with: vercel rollback --token=... (see docs/contributing.rst)."
          exit 1

  linkcheck:
    name: External link check
    if: github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: mamba-org/setup-micromamba@v2
        with:
          environment-file: docs/build-environment.yml
          cache-environment: true
          cache-environment-key: docs-env-${{ hashFiles('docs/build-environment.yml', 'pyproject.toml', 'uv.lock') }}
      - name: Check external links (third-party failures are reported, not blocking)
        shell: bash -el {0}
        run: |
          OPTILAND_DOCS_SKIP_JUPYTERLITE=1 python -m sphinx -b linkcheck --keep-going docs docs/_build/linkcheck || true
          echo "## External link check" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if [ -f docs/_build/linkcheck/output.txt ]; then
            echo '```' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"; head -c 20000 docs/_build/linkcheck/output.txt >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"; echo '```' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi
      - name: Fail on broken first-party links (optiland.org, github.com/optiland)
        shell: bash -el {0}
        run: |
          if [ -f docs/_build/linkcheck/output.txt ] && grep -E "broken.*(optiland\\.org|github\\.com/optiland)" docs/_build/linkcheck/output.txt; then
            echo "Broken first-party links found"; exit 1
          fi
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: docs-linkcheck
          path: docs/_build/linkcheck
          if-no-files-found: warn

  production-smoke:
    name: Production smoke test
    if: github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Verify https://www.optiland.org/docs/
        run: python3 scripts/docs/smoke_test.py --base-url "$DOCS_BASE_URL" --first-party
